title: Quantifying Fairness in LLMs Beyond Tokens: A Semantic and Statistical Perspective
findings: The paper did not evaluate religious bias and therefore presented no findings related to religion. Its findings focused on detecting nuanced biases in long-form text related to gender, race, and age.

measurement_description: The paper's proposed benchmark (FiSCo) was evaluated on gender, race, and age. Religion was mentioned as a dimension in other existing benchmarks discussed, such as StereoSet and BOLD, but was not measured by the new method presented.
